assertions.description: 两条 WIRE_TO_GATE 需求落在两台不同的车上，受理时关卡都不是它们的下一站、没有任何独占行
A 装完后关卡成了它的下一站、被补预占给 A；到关卡后转占用，卸完车还停在那里仍是占用
B 装完时关卡被 A 占着：B 照常出发（AwaitingGateArrival、没有阻断码），关卡仍是 A 的
assertions.expected: B AwaitingGateArrival, gate held by BROKERX-L2-0001
assertions.actual: B AwaitingGateArrival block=, gate held by BROKERX-L2-0001

assertions.description: A 离开关卡、凭离点证据释放之后，下一轮补预占把关卡给 B（RESERVED），B 的预占不早于 A 的释放
assertions.expected: B RESERVED at 210 at or after A's DEPARTED_STATION release
assertions.actual: held: BROKERX-L2-0002 RESERVED; A released 2026-09-29 13:36:09.6434581+00:00 (DEPARTED_STATION); B reserved 2026-09-29 13:36:09.6533994+00:00

assertions.description: 第一条 STAGING_TO_WIRE 受理即预占派工待送站，持有者是接它的那台车那一趟
H 占着派工待送站的整段时间里（在途预占、到站占用、下达离站订单之后），同站的第二条需求一直没被接走
assertions.expected: not accepted; 305 held by BROKERX-L2-0001 OCCUPIED after the departure order
assertions.actual: accepted while reserved: 2026-09-29 13:36:13.7283946+00:00; while occupied: 2026-09-29 13:36:13.7283946+00:00; held BROKERX-L2-0001 OCCUPIED

assertions.description: H 到了机台、凭离点证据释放派工待送站之后，第二条需求才被接走（受理时刻不早于释放时刻）
assertions.expected: accepted at or after H's DEPARTED_STATION release
